target.title: fix(agents): catch subagent sweeper errors instead of leaking unhandled rejections
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`startSweeper` schedules a periodic interval that calls `void sweepSubagentRuns()`. The sweep function has a `try/finally` but no `catch`, so any error thrown while loading session stores or completing runs becomes an unhandled rejection and can crash the agent runtime.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added a `catch` around the sweep body that logs the error and still resets the in-flight flag. The next interval can retry instead of leaking the rejection.

## User Impact

Long-running agent gateways are more resilient to transient subagent session-store errors.

## Evidence

Regression test:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/subagent-registry.test.ts -t "catches and logs sweep errors instead of leaking unhandled rejections"
```

The test fails on current main (`sweepSubagentRuns` rejects with the simulated store error) and passes with the fix.

Real behavior proof:

```bash
node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/proof/subagent-registry-sweeper-catch.mts
```

PASS: subagent sweep error is caught and does not leak.
